posts:
An AI video Skill can produce a render, an editable draft, or a shot plan. Pick the output first.

We mapped 5 creator workflows for motion graphics, whiteboards, wedding stories, editing and Seedance prompts.

Compare tools + setup:
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006#video-workflows

1. Motion graphics: xilo-opus-video by @xilo2991.

Starts with 3 concepts and previews. Choose a direction, then build and render it with code.

Bring a topic or product brief; setup includes Playwright + FFmpeg.
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006&utm_content=code_video#code-video

2. Whiteboard explainers: whiteboard-video by @HanZhang415188.

Hand-drawn scenes, narration, captions and covers. Keep its video-common folder; setup also needs local tools and Volcengine TTS credentials.
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006&utm_content=whiteboard#whiteboard-video

3. Wedding stories: @AaronYiaazw’s guided wizard.

14 stages from the couple’s story to a subtitled film, with script approval, external image/video generation and review checkpoints. Available in English and Chinese.
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006&utm_content=wedding#wedding-video

4. Editable drafts: jianying-editor-skill by luoluoluo22.

Turn your clips, captions and audio into a Jianying desktop draft. The README specifies manual export on macOS; check your app version before starting.
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006&utm_content=editing#jianying-editing

5. Shot plans + prompts: awesome-seedance by LearnPrompt / @aiwarts.

We found 15 Skill entry points, including production planning and style guides. Use a separate video provider to generate footage.
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006&utm_content=seedance#seedance-workflows

Save the comparison for your next video project:
https://www.openagentskill.com/use-cases/video-creation?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=video_workflows_20261006#video-workflows

Source roundup: @jedeeai
https://x.com/jedeeai/status/2107358191432405329

We checked the source documents, not runtime results. Creator tutorials and setup notes are linked on the page.
